subject: Signoff Needed: One-time PLG Credit Boost for Zentrix Pilot
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: one-time PLG credit boost for Zentrix pilot

Hi team,

Quick ask: Zentrix Health (Kevin Park) is running a 90-day pilot for their clinical-notes ingestion workflow. They signed up via PLG, have a clear success metric (30k processed clinical notes / month -> expected embeddings + gen usage), and engineering is asking for a one-time credit grant to remove the friction of billing while they test.

Proposal: issue $30,000 in free credits, valid for 90 days, promo code ZENTRIX-PLG-30K. Activation plan: 1) CS enablement call within 48 hours, 2) gated milestones at 25%/60%/100% consumption for check-ins, 3) convert to committed spend or discontinue after pilot.

Why this is high priority:
- Close velocity: Kevin has procurement engaged and expects a clear path to production if pilot shows token-cost parity with current vendor.
- Upside: estimated ARR if converted ~ $600k/year (they will likely commit for production index).
- Strategic: healthcare buyer, references in region, potential channel for partnerships.

Risks and mitigations:
- Fraud/abuse: cap per-API-key and require lightweight ATO (IP allowlist + billing contact).
- Compliance: Zentrix is SOC2-in-progress; CS will not enable PHI ingest until signed DPA and appropriate contract addendum.

Attachments: pilot proposal + risk matrix. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DEAL-2027-047

Ask: Exec signoff for the $30k credit grant (or counter with a capped immediate release and conditional top-up). Need a final decision by EOD tomorrow to keep procurement on track.

Thanks,
Neha
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Commercial
Redwood Inference

-----
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 11:05:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: one-time PLG credit boost for Zentrix pilot

Neha — thanks for the summary. A few clarifying Qs before I can sign off:
1) Is $30k the minimum needed for them to meaningfully test? Can we stage (e.g., 25k now, 5k on milestone)?
2) Do we have procurement contacts and an NDA/DPA already queued? If PHI will be touched we need the legal checklist.
3) What’s the expected hit to Q1 credits expense if we do this? Can Finance weigh in?

I’m inclined to be conservative on immediate exposure but flexible on conditional top-ups tied to clear technical progress.

-Vivek

-----
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 12:20:15 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: one-time PLG credit boost for Zentrix pilot

Neha — good capture. Approve in principle but recommend we cap immediate grant to $25,000 and hold $5,000 for a milestone release once they demonstrate: 1) automated ingest at >=10k notes/day on our infra, and 2) CS-enabled onboarding completed.

Please confirm:
- DPA signed? If not, require signed DPA before enabling any PHI-related flows.
- Add a clause to convert remaining credits to committed spend if they sign a 12-month contract within 60 days of pilot completion.

Loop in finance to confirm accounting treatment. If everyone is aligned I can OK the $25k immediate release.

Laura
VP, Growth
Redwood Inference

-----
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: one-time PLG credit boost for Zentrix pilot

Thanks — quick update and answers inline:
- Minimum to run pilot: engineering said ~ $22k estimated token/embedding usage to get to our 30k-note/month profile. 25k is feasible as first tranche.
- DPA status: NDA signed, DPA in legal review (expected signed by 3/4). CS confirms no PHI until DPA executed.
- Finance impact: Rishi, I pasted the rough cost estimate in the attached risk matrix. Impact to Q1 credits line is estimated $18k expense (after internal cost allocation).

Plan revision:
1) Release $25,000 now.
2) Hold $5,000 to be released on verification of the two milestones Laura outlined.
3) Promo code: ZENTRIX-PLG-30K (cap 30k; system to allow staged release).

Attachments: zentrix_pilot_proposal_v1.docx; zentrix_risk_matrix.xlsx
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DEAL-2027-047

Can I get a quick sign-off (Laura/Vivek) to push the $25k today and have CS schedule enablement tomorrow?

-Neha

-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:45:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: one-time PLG credit boost for Zentrix pilot

Endorse. My only ask is to log the grant in our billing system as a promo code with expiration and ledger tag 'PLG-PILOT-2027' so Finance can track. Neha, coordinate with Rishi (cc'd) to ensure the accounting flow is in place.

Also suggest we make the $5k top-up automatic on verification (CS + Eng sign-off) to avoid delay. If legal holds the DPA beyond 3/4, pause PHI ingestion but keep the credit active for pseudonymized trials.

-Marissa
Head of Sales, Commercial
Redwood Inference

-----
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 15:34:00 -0700
Subject: Final signoff: Zentrix PLG credit grant

Thanks all — final: sign off $25k immediate grant. Hold $5k for milestone release (automatic on CS/Eng verification). Rishi, please record ledger tag 'PLG-PILOT-2027' and ensure expense hits the marketing/sales trials bucket for Q1. Legal: require DPA before PHI ingest; CS may run pseudonymized tests in the interim.

Neha — proceed to issue promo code and coordinate enablement with CS. Keep me posted on conversion cadence; I want a 30/60/90 day check-in.

-Vivek

-----
External note (cc'd to Kevin in separate outbound):
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Kevin Park <kevin@zentrixhealth.com>, Zentrix Health Procurement <procurement@zentrixhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Zentrix pilot - promo code and next steps

Kevin — quick update: Redwood approved an initial $25,000 promo credit (code ZENTRIX-PLG-30K). We are holding $5k pending two milestones (ingest throughput verification + CS enablement). CS will reach out to schedule onboarding tomorrow. I’ll share the DPA when legal finishes the review (expected 3/4).

Cheers,
Neha
